summary: Existing extraction candidates are all markers for non-neuroendocrine cell types (myofibroblast, endothelial, COL3A1+/p-S6RP+ populations); none match target_cell_scope L4:Neuroendocrine cell. All existing candidates are therefore excluded as out-of-scope.

issues.description: All 5 existing candidate records (ACTA2, TAGLN, VE-Cadherin, p-S6RP, COL3A1) are markers for non-target cell types (myofibroblast, endothelial, collagen/p-S6RP+ populations) and were incorrectly included for target_cell_scope L4:Neuroendocrine cell; they are excluded.
Active scan of the full Markdown found no neuroendocrine cell or pulmonary neuroendocrine cell marker evidence; no formal target marker exists in this paper.
